study type: Randomised Controlled Trial (analysis of RCT data)
exposure: PGE2 vaginal gel induction of labour
Policy of early amniotomy once technically possible
Modified Bishop's score at first review
cohort: The study included 245 term women undergoing induction of labour with PGE2 vaginal gel.
finding: The study found that nulliparity and a lower Modified Bishop's score at first review were independently associated with an increased likelihood of caesarean section and a decreased likelihood of vaginal delivery within 24 hours following prostaglandin induction of labour.
mod_finding: A policy of early amniotomy was associated with a greater likelihood of vaginal delivery within 24 hours and predicted fewer caesarean sections compared to repeat PGE2 administration, regardless of parity or Modified Bishop's score.
